caption: The drawing depicts a long, high-waisted, empire-style dress with long sleeves. The dress is primarily a light blue color with vertical stripes featuring small, repeated floral patterns in shades of gold and brown. The garment extends to the floor and includes a sheer, light-colored underskirt and a similarly sheer scarf draped around the neck and over one shoulder. The illustration does not show a head or hands, and the body is depicted without visible facial features. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a smaller line drawing of the same dress from the back, showing the length of the dress and detailing the scarf draped down the back.
